proof_summary: Derive the recurrence \(a(n+1)=(2^n-1)a(n)+2^{\binom{n+1}{2}}\). For odd primes, Fermat’s theorem makes its coefficients and inhomogeneous term invariant under the shift \(2(p-1)\), and the shifted base value collapses to \(1\), so induction applies; modulo \(2\), the same recurrence shows every positive-index term is \(1\).
